A single-player incremental game where you rip open boosters and complete the ultimate card collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear, and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Fill every page in a satisfying 3-5 hour session. Your binder is waiting!

Developed and published by: Cybernetic Walrus
